source.note: Wave-1 row 62 named the Quaternius Animated Creatures/Dinosaurs Apatosaurus on poly.pizza (Cloudflare challenge). This is the same Quaternius dinosaur pack (Dec 2018) from its itch.io page, CC0, fetched as for the t-rex and velociraptor. Height: the rest pose carries the neck about level, so its top (the head, 5.4 m) sits just above the back; at 5.4 m the back over the hips is ~4.6 m and the length 23 m, an adult Apatosaurus (21-23 m long, ~4.5 m at the hips). The neck raised high (~9 m head height) is not a pose the rig rests in. The pack ships this rig's death clip under the name Stegosaurus_Death; it is keyed for this skeleton and plays correctly.
